concerns.title: Facial treatments for dry skin | In2Skin, Bolton
intro: Dry skin is not just a feeling; it shows in tightness after washing, flaking around the nose and brows, and makeup that never quite sits the way it should. A facial treatment for dry skin is built around putting moisture back in gently, and keeping it there, rather than scrubbing the surface harder.

At In2Skin, every dry-skin facial treatment starts with a look at your skin that day. Ontario winters, dry indoor air and the wrong products at home can all leave skin thirsty, and the treatment is chosen for what your skin needs now, not from a fixed routine.

sections.h: How a facial treatment helps dry skin
body: The Classic Facial, 55 minutes, suits dry skin well: a gentle deep cleanse, steam to soften, extractions only if needed, then a hydration mask and a facial massage that includes the neck and décolletage. The massage itself helps, encouraging the skin to take in the moisture from the mask and the Circadia professional skincare used through the treatment.

Light Therapy, 20 minutes, can be added to the same visit. Warm red light pairs naturally with a hydration mask, and many clients with dry skin find the combination leaves their face feeling calm and supple rather than tight.

sections.h: What to avoid, and what helps at home
body: Dry skin is often made worse by harsh cleansers, very hot water, and exfoliating too often at home. During your visit, Sarah will talk through what you are using now and suggest a simpler routine with Circadia products matched to your skin, so the facial treatment is not undone by the first wash at home.
Regular visits every four to six weeks help dry skin stay steady through the seasons, especially from late autumn into spring, when indoor heating dries the air and the skin with it.

faq: Will a facial treatment make my dry skin worse?

No. A facial treatment for dry skin is gentle by design, with a hydration mask, massage and products chosen for your skin that day. Nothing harsh is used, and Sarah will explain each step as it happens.
How often should I book for dry skin?
Every four to six weeks is a good rhythm, with more frequent visits in winter if your skin feels tight and flaky.
What should I book first?
The Classic Facial, 55 minutes, is the best first visit, with Light Therapy as an optional addition. If you are new to In2Skin, the 20-minute consultation can help settle the plan.

concerns.title: Facial treatments for teen acne | In2Skin, Bolton
intro: Breakouts in the teenage years are common, and they are also deeply personal. A teen who is self-conscious about their skin needs a treatment that is gentle, honest and unhurried, with everything explained as it happens and no judgement about how they have been looking after their skin at home.

This page is for children and teenagers, and for the adults who bring them. If you are an adult dealing with breakouts of your own, the adult page, Acne-prone skin, covers the same care with treatments shaped for adult skin.

sections.h: A calm first facial treatment for a teenager
body: The Classic Facial, 55 minutes, is the recommended first step for teen acne. It covers a thorough deep cleanse, gentle exfoliation, steam, and a hydration mask, with extractions only where they are needed and only if the skin allows. Everything is explained as it happens, so a teenager who has never had a facial treatment knows what is coming next.

The visit is private and one-on-one, which matters for a young person who may not want an audience. A parent is welcome to be nearby for the conversation at the start, and Sarah will talk through a simple home routine that a teenager can actually keep up.

sections.h: What helps, and what to leave alone
body: Teen breakouts are usually made worse by picking, by harsh scrubs, and by piling on too many products at once. A facial treatment clears away the dull surface build-up that traps oil and clogs pores, then calms the skin with hydration matched to the skin that day.

Microdermabrasion, 20 minutes, can be added when the skin suits it, as a gentle polish that sweeps away rough surface cells so pores stay clearer. Regular visits every four to six weeks help keep breakouts under control, and the routine at home is kept simple on purpose: cleanse, hydrate, and leave the skin alone in between.

faq: Is a facial treatment suitable for teenagers?
Yes. The Classic Facial is a gentle first step for teen acne, and everything is explained as it happens. A parent can be part of the conversation at the start of the visit.
Will extractions hurt?
Extractions are only done where the skin allows, and they are done gently. If the skin is too tender, they are left alone and the rest of the facial treatment carries the visit.
How often should a teenager book?
Every four to six weeks is a good rhythm while breakouts are active. The home routine Sarah suggests is kept simple so it is easy to follow.

occasions.title: Facial treatments before your wedding | In2Skin, Bolton
intro: A wedding day is photographed from every angle, and the skin in those photographs is the skin you have been living in, not something made in a morning. The best wedding skin care is a small plan made ahead of time, with treatments your skin has already tried and liked.

In2Skin works with brides and bridal parties from Bolton and the surrounding towns. The studio is private and one-on-one, so a wedding facial treatment is a calm hour to yourself in the middle of a busy season, not another appointment to get through.

sections.h: Book ahead, and try things early
body: Book ahead, and keep the first treatment well before the day. A first facial treatment should never be the week of the wedding, because new treatments can surprise even good skin. Start with the Classic Facial, 55 minutes, and see how your skin responds before adding anything else.

If you would like to try Light Therapy, Microdermabrasion, or Microneedling and NANO Needling, try them at an earlier visit first. What suits your skin can then be repeated closer to the day with confidence, and anything that does not suit is simply left out.

Bridal parties can book one at a time, with each person choosing the treatment that fits their own skin. The Classic Facial is a safe, complete choice for most of the party, and The Works, a facial treatment with red light and reflexology at once, is a kind gift for a bridesmaid who has been on her feet all week.

If anyone in the party lives far away, the 20-minute consultation can be done by video, so their treatment is planned before they travel. Gift certificates are also available if you would rather give a treatment than book it yourself.

faq: When should I book my first facial treatment before a wedding?
Book ahead, and have your first facial treatment well before the wedding, so you know how your skin responds. Repeat the treatments that suited you closer to the day.
Can my bridal party book together?
Each person books their own appointment, one at a time, and chooses the treatment that fits their skin. Call (289) 212-4124 if you would like help arranging visits for a group.
What is the best facial treatment before a wedding?
The Classic Facial, 55 minutes, is the best starting point. The Works adds red light and reflexology for a fuller visit, and a consultation can settle the plan for your skin.

occasions.title: Facial treatments before the workday | In2Skin, Bolton
intro: Some weeks ask more of your face than others: a presentation, a run of meetings, a photograph, or a day when you simply need to look rested. A facial treatment before that kind of week is not vanity; it is preparation, the same as pressing a suit or preparing notes.

In2Skin is a private studio in Bolton, one guest at a time. Regular appointments start between 10 AM and 4 PM, Monday to Saturday, and early mornings and evenings can be arranged by contacting Sarah for anyone whose working day does not leave room in the middle of it.

body: The Classic Facial, 55 minutes, is the straightforward choice before a busy week. A deep cleanse, steam, extractions if needed, a hydration mask, and a facial massage including the neck and décolletage leave skin clean and settled, with no downtime, so you can go straight back to your day.

Light Therapy, 20 minutes, can be added to the same visit for a calmer, more even look. It pairs naturally with a facial treatment and needs no recovery time, which is why professionals often add it before a week of being seen.

sections.h: Making it a habit, not a one-off
body: A facial treatment every four to six weeks keeps skin steady through long weeks, late nights and dry office air, rather than needing a rescue the week something important happens. The routine at home is kept simple, with Circadia professional skincare matched to your skin, so the results of a visit last until the next one.
If you are unsure what your skin needs, the 20-minute consultation, video or in person, is open to first-time clients, and it can be done by video if you would rather not travel for a conversation.

faq: Can I book a facial treatment before work?
Regular appointments start between 10 AM and 4 PM, Monday to Saturday. Early mornings and evenings can be arranged by contacting Sarah.
Will my skin be red after a facial treatment?
The Classic Facial leaves skin clean and settled, with no downtime. If a stronger treatment is planned, Sarah will say so beforehand and suggest the right timing.
What should I book before an important week?
The Classic Facial, 55 minutes, with Light Therapy added if you would like a calmer, more even look. Book online or call (289) 212-4124.

occasions.title: Facial treatments before your vacation | In2Skin, Bolton
intro: A holiday photographs better when your skin is already in good shape, and the sun, salt water and long days outdoors are kinder to skin that has been looked after first. A facial treatment before you travel is a small piece of preparation, done while you still have time to enjoy it.
In2Skin is a private studio in Bolton, one guest at a time. Book a visit in the days before you leave, and travel with skin that is clean, hydrated and settled.

body: The Classic Facial, 55 minutes, is the natural choice before a trip: a deep cleanse, steam, extractions if needed, a hydration mask, and a facial massage including the neck and décolletage, with Circadia professional skincare chosen for your skin that day.

Microdermabrasion, 20 minutes, can be added for a gentle polish that sweeps away dull surface cells, so skin looks brighter in photographs and takes sun care more evenly. It is a light treatment with no downtime, which suits a week when you are packing and tying up loose ends.

Have your facial treatment a few days before you travel, rather than the day before, so your skin has time to settle and you are not rushing from the studio to the airport. If you are trying a treatment for the first time, try it even earlier, at a visit before the one closest to your trip.

If you live far from Bolton and would like guidance before travelling, the 20-minute consultation for first-time clients can be done by video. Gift certificates are also a thoughtful present for someone about to travel.

faq: When should I have a facial treatment before a vacation?
A few days before you travel, so your skin has time to settle. If it is a treatment you have never tried, have it at an earlier visit first.
What is the best facial treatment before a holiday?
The Classic Facial, 55 minutes, with Microdermabrasion added if you would like a brighter look. Book online or call (289) 212-4124.
Can I book if I live far away?
Yes. The consultation can be done by video, and the studio welcomes clients from across the surrounding towns. Directions are sent with your booking.

occasions.title: After-hours appointments | In2Skin, Bolton
intro: Not everyone can make a daytime appointment. Work, school runs and family commitments fill the middle of the day, and a facial treatment should not have to wait for a free afternoon that never comes. In2Skin offers early-morning and evening visits, arranged by contacting Sarah, for anyone whose days are spoken for.
These visits are the same private, one-on-one appointments as the daytime ones: one guest, one calm room, and a treatment chosen for your skin that day.

body: Regular hours are Monday to Saturday, with appointments starting between 10 AM and 4 PM, and the studio is closed on Sundays. Early mornings and evenings sit outside those hours and are arranged by contacting Sarah, who will find a time that fits around your day.

To arrange one, call (289) 212-4124 or write to bookings@boltonfacials.com and say what kind of time you need. The booking is confirmed in the same way as a daytime visit, and directions are sent with your booking.

sections.h: A longer visit, when the day is done
body: Evening visits suit the longer treatments, because there is nothing after them to rush back to. The Anti-Aging Facial, 80 minutes, is a slow treatment with two masks and an arm massage while the second mask is on, and The Works pairs a facial treatment with red light and reflexology at the same time.

If you would rather keep it short, the Classic Facial, 55 minutes, is a complete treatment on its own, and a 20-minute consultation beforehand can be done by video if that is easier than another trip.

faq: How do I book an early-morning or evening appointment?
Contact Sarah by calling (289) 212-4124 or writing to bookings@boltonfacials.com, and say what kind of time you need. Early mornings and evenings are arranged with her directly.
Are after-hours visits the same as daytime ones?
Yes. The same private, one-on-one appointment, the same treatments, and the same care, at a time that fits your day.
Is the studio open on Sundays?
No. The studio is closed on Sundays. Regular hours are Monday to Saturday, with appointments starting between 10 AM and 4 PM.

info.title: How to choose your facial treatment | In2Skin, Bolton
intro: Choosing a facial treatment should not feel like a test. There are two main facial treatments at In2Skin, a handful of shorter treatments that can be added to them or booked on their own, and one longer visit that brings several things together at once. This page sets them out in plain words, so you can choose with confidence.
If you would still rather talk it through, the 20-minute consultation, video or in person, is made for first-time clients, and Sarah will recommend a treatment based on your skin, not on a menu.

body: The Classic Facial is the everyday facial treatment, and the best first visit. It covers a deep cleanse, steam, extractions if needed, a hydration mask, and a facial massage that includes the neck and décolletage, with Circadia professional skincare matched to your skin that day.

Choose it if you want clean, settled, hydrated skin, if you have never had a facial treatment, or if you are booking a regular visit every four to six weeks. It suits most skin, including sensitive and acne-prone skin, and it has no downtime.

The Anti-Aging Facial includes all of the Classic Facial, then adds a second mask, an arm massage while that second mask is on, and serums with Circadia products worked into the masks and matched to your skin.

Choose it if your skin feels dry or tired, if fine lines are your main concern, or if you simply want a longer, slower visit. It is the facial treatment to book when the treatment itself is the point of the trip, rather than something fitted between errands.

Microneedling and NANO Needling are one treatment, 20 minutes, with Sarah choosing the needle size at the visit. Microdermabrasion, Light Therapy and Reflexology are each 20 minutes. Any of them can be added to a facial treatment or booked on its own, and Sarah will say plainly whether one suits your skin.

Chemical Peels, 55 minutes including a consultation, are matched to your skin before anything is decided, with the strength chosen at the consultation. The Works is a facial treatment with red light and reflexology running at the same time, so one visit covers skin, rest and tired feet together.

faq: I have never had a facial treatment. Where do I start?
The Classic Facial, 55 minutes, is the best first visit. If you would like guidance first, book the 20-minute consultation, video or in person.
What is the difference between the Classic and Anti-Aging facial treatments?

The Anti-Aging Facial includes everything in the Classic Facial, then adds a second mask, an arm massage while that mask is on, and serums with Circadia products matched to your skin. It is 80 minutes, and it suits dry, tired skin and fine lines.
Can I add a shorter treatment to a facial treatment?
Yes. Microneedling and NANO Needling, Microdermabrasion, Light Therapy and Reflexology can each be added to a facial treatment or booked on their own. Sarah will advise what suits your skin.

info.title: Consultation | In2Skin, Bolton
intro: The consultation is a 20-minute conversation about your skin, for first-time clients only. It can be done by video or in person at the studio in Bolton, and it is the right starting point if you are unsure which treatment fits, if your skin has been unpredictable, or if you are considering a Chemical Peel.

There is nothing to prepare. Come as you are, bring the products you use at home if you would like to talk through them, and Sarah will ask about your skin, your routine, and what you hope a treatment will do.

body: Sarah will look at your skin, ask about your routine and any concerns, and talk through what she sees. Together you will settle on a treatment plan, which may be a single facial treatment, a facial treatment with an add-on, or a series of visits over time.
The consultation is credited in full toward your first treatment, so the cost of the conversation goes toward the care that follows it. The booking button shows the consultation price when you book.

A video consultation works well if you live far from Bolton, if your days are full, or if you would simply rather talk first before travelling. The video link is sent with your booking, and the conversation is the same as it would be in the room.

An in-person consultation suits anyone who would like their skin seen up close before a treatment is chosen, and it is the right choice before a Chemical Peel. Either way, the consultation is only for first-time clients, and returning clients book their treatment directly.

faq: How long is the consultation?
20 minutes, by video or in person at the studio in Bolton.
Is the consultation only for first-time clients?
Yes. The consultation is for first-time clients only. Returning clients book their treatment directly, and Sarah can still answer questions at the start of any visit.
Is the consultation credited toward a treatment?
Yes. The consultation is credited in full toward your first treatment. The booking button shows the consultation price when you book.

info.title: Contact In2Skin | Bolton, Ontario
intro: In2Skin is a private one-on-one aesthetics studio in Bolton, Ontario. The easiest way to book is online, and the easiest way to ask a question is by phone or email. Sarah answers personally, and she will help you choose a treatment, a time, or a gift.

Phone: (289) 212-4124. Email: bookings@boltonfacials.com. The studio serves Bolton and the surrounding towns, including Caledon, Kleinburg, Vaughan, Brampton, Nobleton, King City, Orangeville, Georgetown, Toronto and Mississauga.

body: Regular hours are Monday to Saturday, with appointments starting between 10 AM and 4 PM. The studio is closed on Sundays. Early mornings and evenings can be arranged by contacting Sarah.
Appointments are by booking only, one guest at a time. Please arrive 5 to 10 minutes early for your first visit, and come as you are; there is nothing special to wear or bring.
The studio address is sent with your booking, along with directions and parking details. If you are unsure about the route, call (289) 212-4124 and Sarah will talk you through it.
If you need to change or cancel a visit, please give 24 hours notice where you can. Changes and cancellations with 24 hours notice are free, and Sarah will help you find another time that fits.

faq: What is the phone number for In2Skin?
Call (289) 212-4124. You can also write to bookings@boltonfacials.com.
When is the studio open?
Monday to Saturday, with appointments starting between 10 AM and 4 PM. The studio is closed on Sundays, and early mornings and evenings can be arranged by contacting Sarah.
How do I find the studio?
The address is sent with your booking, along with directions and parking details.

info.title: Gift certificates | In2Skin, Bolton
intro: A gift certificate from In2Skin is a calm hour given to someone you care about, in a private studio where one guest is treated at a time. It suits birthdays, thank-yous, new mothers, and anyone who would never book a facial treatment for themselves.
You can gift a named treatment, such as the Classic Facial or the Anti-Aging Facial, or any amount, and the certificate code is emailed to you or to the person receiving it.

body: Choose a named treatment or any amount, and the certificate code is emailed after purchase. The person receiving it books online or by calling (289) 212-4124, and quotes the code when they book.

A certificate never expires. If the treatment booked costs less than the certificate, the leftover stays on the code for a future visit, so nothing is lost. If it costs more, the difference is simply paid at the visit.

Gift certificates can be bought for someone in Bolton or any of the surrounding towns, and the studio welcomes clients from across the area. Directions and parking details are sent with the booking, as with any other visit.
If you are unsure which treatment to give, the Classic Facial, 55 minutes, is a safe and complete choice for most people, and the recipient can always talk it through with Sarah before their visit.

faq: Do gift certificates expire?
No. A gift certificate never expires, and any leftover stays on the code for a future visit.
Can I gift a named treatment or any amount?
Either. Gift a named treatment, such as the Classic Facial, or any amount, and the certificate code is emailed after purchase.
How does the recipient book?
They book online at boltonfacials.com or call (289) 212-4124, and quote the certificate code when they book.
